scenes.title: Loftus 1974 & 1995 Memory Lab: clean two-sedan collision screen + four-story 'Lost in the Mall' booklet
scenes.era: 1974 & 1995 University of Washington Memory Laboratory, Seattle

layout.description: Bright minimalist psychology screening & interview room with two unpainted matte-porcelain scale sedans resting nose-to-fender on a clean gray test-track table beside a wall projection frame, while an adult volunteer sits across an oak interview desk holding a four-page cream booklet.

positions.who: Adult eyewitness volunteer (clothed matte-white porcelain figure with smooth featureless solid matte-white egg-shaped oval head in olive knit sweater and beige slacks)
positions.where: seated at the oak interview desk holding a wooden pencil over a four-story cream booklet
positions.facing: facing the psychologist and test-track display

positions.who: Memory psychologist (clothed matte-white porcelain figure with smooth featureless solid matte-white egg-shaped oval head in tailored charcoal blazer over cream shirt)
positions.where: seated opposite at the oak desk sliding the four-story booklet forward
positions.facing: facing the volunteer across the oak desk

props.name: two minimalist matte sedans nose-to-fender on clean gray asphalt track with zero broken glass
props.period_detail: 1970s four-door sedan silhouettes on spotless gray surface without a single glass shard
props.physical_behavior: cars meet cleanly bumper-to-fender leaving the gray surface completely free of debris

props.name: cream four-page childhood story booklet and unpainted cedar pencil
props.period_detail: blank-text cream paper interview booklet divided into four story panels
props.physical_behavior: psychologist slides the open booklet across the oak desk as the volunteer taps the fourth page confidently

actions.verb_sequence: slides the open four-panel cream booklet across the oak desk -> points one porcelain finger beside the clean two-sedan collision model

reactions.reaction: nods firmly and taps the cedar pencil onto the booklet in total confidence despite zero broken glass on the track

scenes.wardrobe: Volunteer in olive knit crew sweater and beige trousers; psychologist in tailored charcoal blazer over cream collared blouse.
scenes.lighting: Crisp bright architectural daylight studio illumination.
scenes.recognition_hook: Two cars bump with zero broken glass — yet changing one verb or slipping one fake page into a family booklet makes 1 in 4 brains swear they saw it.

key_visual.description: two minimalist matte sedans meeting bumper-to-fender on clean spotless gray pavement while a porcelain psychologist in a charcoal blazer hands a cream booklet to a porcelain volunteer at an oak desk

scenes.title: Everyday argument memory drift vs timestamped written notes

layout.description: Sunlit minimalist oak dining table where two porcelain adults compare a small open pocket notebook peacefully instead of arguing from memory.

positions.who: Two porcelain adults in olive and cream knitwear
positions.where: seated across a sunlit oak table looking down at an open pocket notebook

props.name: unmarked linen-bound pocket notebook and ceramic mugs
props.period_detail: clean tactile paper notebook with zero readable lettering
props.physical_behavior: both porcelain hands rest calmly beside the open notebook as shoulders relax

actions.verb_sequence: opens the linen pocket notebook flat on the oak table -> rests open palm peacefully beside it

reactions.reaction: inclines smooth oval head in calm agreement

scenes.wardrobe: Olive and warm cream knit sweaters.
scenes.recognition_hook: Written receipts protect relationships from sincere hippocampal editing.

props.physical_behavior: electric cyan-blue hippocampus weaves warm amber-gold temporal lobe semantic strands into a crimson-red flash of mistaken prefrontal certainty
